clips.end_words: the seed of a greater benefit
clips.caption:
A forest fire looks like the end of everything. It's actually the only way new growth gets to happen — the old foliage has to burn before anything fresh can break through the ground.

Your life runs on the same law. Every door that closes, every plan that collapses, every version of you that gets wiped out — it's making room. You can't create a void and keep clinging to what was sitting in it.

There's an old line worth sitting with: in every adversity is the seed of a greater benefit. Not despite the fire. Because of it.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to find the seed in yours.

clips.start_words: So in my life, I never
clips.caption:
Most people spend years trying to overcome their worst moment. He says he's never had one to overcome.

Not because nothing ever went wrong — plenty did. But every single time, he refused to call it adversity. Someone else's disaster is, in his words, a gift he just got from the universe. Same event, completely different field it lands in.

That's not denial. It's a decision made before the bad news even arrives: whatever this is, there's a treasure inside it, and finding it is the only job.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to make that decision before you need it.

#mindset #universallaw #awakening #consciousness #subconscious #kevintrudeau

Job had everything — wealth, family, friends. Then all of it was taken, down to boils covering his own body. Scripture records exactly what he said: what I feared most has come upon me.

That line is the whole mechanism. What you think about, you get — fear included. He didn't get punished for having things. He got what he'd been rehearsing in his mind the entire time.

The turn came when he let go of needing any particular outcome and surrendered anyway. What came back wasn't equal to what he lost. It was a hundredfold.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how surrender actually works.
